description: The pie chart, labeled "Answer Types," visually represents the distribution of different question formats within the MathOdyssey benchmark dataset. It contains three distinct slices: the largest segment, colored green, is labeled "Open-Answer (244)" and accounts for 63.0% of the total; the second largest, colored orange, is labeled "True-False (16)" and represents 32.8%; and the smallest segment, colored blue, is labeled "Multi-Choice (127)" and makes up 4.1%. The chart includes percentage labels directly inside each slice and a title beneath it. The three categories are arranged in descending order of size, clockwise from the top.
